sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "project_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "due_date" TEXT NULL, "due_minute" INTEGER NULL, "recurrence" TEXT NULL, "next_task_id" INTEGER NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habits" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "schedule" TEXT NOT NULL, "target" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habit_check_ins" ("habit_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES habits (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), PRIMARY KEY ("habit_id", "date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "kind" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_minute" INTEGER NULL, "duration_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "recurrence" TEXT NULL, "reminder_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_exceptions" ("event_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "skipped" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("skipped" IN (0, 1)), "done_at" TEXT NULL, "moved_date" TEXT NULL, "moved_minute" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), PRIMARY KEY ("event_id", "date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routines" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_of_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "schedule" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_minute" INTEGER NULL, "reminder_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_steps" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "routine_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES routines (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_runs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "routine_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES routines (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "finished_at" TEXT NULL, "steps_done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "steps_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "water_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "logged_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_ml" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sleep_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "date" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "bedtime" TEXT NOT NULL, "wake_time" TEXT NOT NULL, "quality" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workouts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "finished_at" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "workout_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workouts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "set_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reps" INTEGER NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("done" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));
CREATE INDEX tasks_due_date ON tasks (due_date)
CREATE INDEX tasks_completed_at ON tasks (completed_at)
CREATE INDEX tasks_deleted_at ON tasks (deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX habit_check_ins_date ON habit_check_ins (date)
CREATE INDEX events_start_date ON events (start_date)
CREATE INDEX routine_steps_routine ON routine_steps (routine_id)
CREATE INDEX routine_runs_date ON routine_runs (date)
CREATE INDEX water_logs_date ON water_logs (date)
CREATE INDEX workouts_started ON workouts (started_at)
CREATE INDEX workout_sets_workout ON workout_sets (workout_id)
CREATE INDEX workout_sets_exercise ON workout_sets (exercise_id)
